'''Pemmin Brunce''' was an [[Ongidae]]<ref name="Databank" /> [[Gender|male]] who was the head of security for the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]. 

==Biography==
Although Brunce and his bouncers were responsible for dealing with the day to day security at the casino, the [[Canto Bight Police Department]] could be called in to handle the most major disturbances. He and his team used silent hand signals to communicate.<ref name="TLJVD" /> During the [[Cold War]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], Brunce spotted the former casino employee [[Kaljach Sonmi]] inside the building and tried to throw him out; however, the [[Suerton]] [[Gambling|gambler]] [[Dodibin]] helped Sonmi earn enough [[cantocoin]]s in a [[hazard toss]] bet to meet the minimum amount needed for him to remain and so Brunce let him be.<ref name="Ride" /> Brunce had [[Color|pink]] skin and gray [[eye]]s and was the only employee in the casino permitted to scowl. He wore a pair of black pants and [[boot]]s with smartly tailored black [[Clothing|jacket]] that concealed a [[stun baton]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pemmin Brunce was created for the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]]; however, prior to the films release he appeared in the short story "[[The Ride]]," which was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and released as part of the [[Canto Bight (novella collection)|''Canto Bight'']] anthology on [[December 5]], 2017.<ref name="details">{{SW|url=news/check-out-the-cover-and-new-details-of-journey-to-star-wars-the-last-jedi-canto-bight|text=Check Out the Cover and New Details of Journey to ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' - ''Canto Bight''}}</ref> Brunce was portrayed by creature and droid performer [[Cavin Cornwall]] in the film, with puppeteer [[Mark Jefferis]] controlling the character's animatronic facial expressions.<ref name="Nick Kellington interview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsinterviews.com/sequel-trilogy/episode-viii-the-last-jedi/nick-kellington-snook-uccorfay|text=Nick Kellington - Snook Uccorfay (The Last Jedi)|author=Pellegrom, Dennis|work=[https://www.starwarsinterviews.com Star Wars Interviews]|archivedate=20180112193203|nolive=1}}</ref>
